checks.content: Interpret the pragmatic next action of an unexpectedly early arrival; meeting the visitor naturally follows, whereas the relevant-sounding prior audit report does not address the arrival. checks.audio: Whisper small.en exact A/B/C and bodies in both modes. Independent Vosk corroborated relevant meanings and comparative “newer” in “newer model”.
checks.association: Exact SHA-bound formal and practice WAVs, separate throughout with original accent and roles per mode, dialogue keyed to the same written options. Kept original number cue audio and scored answer window; exact offline structural/timing validation only.
